What can I watch next?

A tool for when you cannot find anything to watch. Takes about two minutes, and there is nothing to sign up for.

Welcome back.

PickTick the films and series you have watched and enjoyed. As many or as few as you like.

Say what workedThe writing, the acting, the editing, the tone. Tick a whole category, go deeper, or skip it.

Name your moodWhat you want right now, which is not the same as what you generally like.

Everything happens in your browser. Nothing is stored anywhere but on your own device.

Have a watch history to hand?

This step is optional, so click skip if you would rather not upload anything. If you do have one to hand, Netflix lets you download yours as a CSV straight from the website. Other services vary. Drop one in and everything on it comes off the suggestion list. It never leaves your browser.

Most people skip this. The rest works exactly the same without it.

Which of these have you watched and enjoyed?

Tick anything you genuinely enjoyed. There is no limit, and no minimum beyond a few. The more you tick, the better the reading of your taste.

What was it that you liked?

Tick whichever categories apply. Tick none, tick a few, tick everything, it is up to you. Skip any title you would rather not think about.

What are you in the mood for, right now?

Pick as many as fit, or none at all. This is about tonight rather than about you in general, and it leads the recommendations.

When was it made?

Leave these alone for anything, any era.
